# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Router generado por /api/core/generate-code — Resumen de Documentos."""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import Any, Dict

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

logger = logging.getLogger("AURA.resumen_docs")

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/resumen_docs", tags=["resumen_docs"])


class ResumenDocsRequest(BaseModel):
    payload: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class ResumenDocsResponse(BaseModel):
    ok: bool = True
    data: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


@router.post("/run", response_model=ResumenDocsResponse)
def run(req: ResumenDocsRequest) -> ResumenDocsResponse:
    """Ejecuta Resumen de Documentos."""
    try:
        logger.info("resumen_docs: ejecutando")
        return ResumenDocsResponse(ok=True, data={"received": req.payload})
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(exc))
